accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, timer toggles) MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.
accessibility_and_testing.kitchen_ergonomics: Minimum touch target size 48px, high contrast text contrast >= 4.5:1, bold labels for easy viewing from a distance while working in the kitchen.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark colors as aggressive gradients. Prefer flat warm natural tones with subtle 1px warm borders.
Do NOT center align body text or recipe forms. Maintain left alignment for readability.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on fixed headers or sticky overlays. Always use high opacity blur like bg-[#FDFBF7]/95 or dark equivalent.
Ensure the bottom navigation bar is fixed, responsive, and easily clickable with one thumb on mobile devices.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
When rendering formula output in 'Calcola gradi', display both Celsius values and step-by-step breakdown clearly in font-mono.
Under NO circumstances include any freezer / congelatore features in 'Pianifica la produzione'.
In 'Maestro > Aggiungi ricetta', keep the recipe list clean without pre-loaded dummy recipes, allowing the user to create their own from scratch.
In 'Maestro > Gestione forno', keep it as a clean oven timing & steam phase controller without pre-loaded recipe examples.
In 'Il Maestro sa tutto', include the specific phrase: 'Chiedi e ti sarà dato' along with YouTube video embeds and Stuttgart local announcements.
